description: Prepare a sanitized public Ceraph defect report and check GitHub CLI authentication. Submit only with explicit user approval or a matching account-bound lasting preference. Preview first when consent is absent; never attach source, logs, media, or credentials.

action.description: Preview a sanitized report, submit an approved report, or change the account-bound reporting preference. Defaults to preview.

actual.description: Observed Ceraph behavior, without private app information or credentials.

code.description: Public Ceraph error or condition code, if available.

expected.description: Expected Ceraph behavior, without private app information or credentials.

platform.description: Affected mobile platform, or host for a computer-side defect.

preference.description: Lasting reporting choice for action:'preference': ask for approval, allow future submissions, or disable submissions.

projectDir.description: React Native/Expo project directory. Omit when the coding client's workspace identifies one app; supply it to disambiguate projects.

summary.description: Concise Ceraph defect, without app code, private identifiers, logs, URLs, or customer data.

tool.description: Ceraph tool name associated with the defect, if known.

userApproved.description: True only when the user explicitly authorized this public submission or lasting reporting preference.

name: ceraph_report_issue
